title: pretty FLORENCIA|Plus Size Midi Printed Mermaid Chiffon Dress
descriptionHtml:
This plus size dress in champagne print floral brings a soft, romantic feel to any special occasion. The V-neckline and wrap-style front help shape the waist beautifully, while the flutter sleeves add light coverage and an easy, feminine touch. Finished with a flowy high low hem, it moves gracefully and feels just right for wedding guest looks, garden parties, and other dressy moments.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: High low.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: Side back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is non-stretch.
